title: 1986 AHSME Problem 10
statement: The \(120\) permutations of AHSME are arranged in dictionary order, as if each were an ordinary five-letter word. The last letter of the \(86\)th word in this list is

solutions.text:
Each first letter occupies a block of \(4!=24\) words. Positions \(73\) through \(96\) begin with \(M,\) so the \(86\)th word is the \(14\)th word in that block. The first \(6\) begin with \(MA,\) the next \(6\) with \(ME,\) and the \(13\)th through \(18\)th begin with \(MH.\) The first two of those are \(MHAES\) and \(MHASE.\) Thus the \(86\)th word ends in E.

Therefore the correct answer is E.
hints: Group the words into blocks of \(4!\) according to their first letter
Within the \(M\)-block, group by the second letter and then list only the needed small block
